experiment: E47 dual-model system: CNN identity + logSPD novelty rejection
motivation: E45 showed a raw-waveform CNN with PGD7 adversarial training lifts PGD20/SNR20 direct accuracy from 0.082 to 0.55 and macro RA to 0.748, but its softmax confidence cannot reject unknown subjects (U 0.016). E46 showed CNN embedding distances also fail (U<=0.30). E36 logSPD WCCN still has pseudo-unknown AUROC 0.998. Splitting the duties recovers both: CNN for identity, logSPD distance_ratio for novelty rejection.

data.source: Train session1 only; read-only reuse of E36 raw and zband caches

identity_model.architecture: Conv1d(18->96,k9,s2)-BN-ELU 递进到 384 通道, global average pool, linear K
identity_model.training: 40 epochs, AdamW lr 3e-3 cosine, 0.5*CE(clean)+0.5*CE(PGD7 adversarial), SNR20/30 各半, 25% 目标攻击

rejection_model.type: frozen E36 detrend_zband_cov5_wccn_prototype, same fit split
rejection_model.threshold_rule: threshold = q05 of this run's clean-known distance_ratio
rejection_model.leakage_note: 阈值只来自 clean known，绝不使用 pseudo-unknown 或 Test 的分位数来定阈值；U 是测出来的结果，不是调出来的目标

decision: logSPD distance_ratio < threshold -> 0, otherwise CNN argmax identity

evaluation.inner_folds: E36 five outer groups x two inner folds, identical subject splits and blocks
evaluation.subset: E36 stratified first 8 trials per identity/task for clean known and pseudo-unknown
evaluation.attack_target_model: the CNN identity model (white-box); E44 showed transfer is not weaker
evaluation.aggregation: per inner run in its own label space, average two inner runs, then average five outer folds

sensitivity.purpose: 只报告，不用于选择；主规则固定 q05 与 E36/E40 一致

targets.note: E47 首次同时具备高 RA 与高 U 的机制；判断以官方 Score 与各门禁为准

reporting.evidence_boundary: Train-only inner nesting, pseudo-unknown subjects, continuous file-block proxy, white-box attacks against the CNN. No outer selection, no Test, no cross-session claim.
